newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia senior parliamentarian Panizza dies.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia senior parliamentarian Panizza dies.

text.p: Australian government senior parliamentary official John Panizza died on Thursday night in Queensland, the office of the president of the upper house Senate, Margaret Reid, said on Friday.
Panizza, 65, was the government's whip in the Senate and died while on parliamentary business to Queensland.
He was elected to the Senate for the state of Western Australia in 1987 and was appointed government whip following the Liberal-National coalition election victory in March 1996.
